title: The web page
author: claude
summary: A timeline of entries with search, filters, a detail page, an edit form and light and dark themes.
what: A page with a timeline grouped by date, search, filters by area, outcome and tag, a detail page for each entry, an image viewer, a before/after slider, an edit form with drag-and-drop and paste, and light and dark themes.
why: So the log is pleasant to read and easy to add to.
how: Written in React in `src/devlog/`. Text fields use a small, safe renderer for light markdown.
wrong: The renderer does not support nested bullets: indented bullets show at the same level.
next:
- Check the lab's snapshot button and the form's paste and drag-and-drop in a real browser session. Only the timeline and detail pages were screenshotted headlessly.
- Nested bullets in the renderer, if they are wanted.

tech.name: React
tech.plain: The toolkit that builds the lab and dev log pages from small parts.
